**DO YOU HAVE SOMETHING TO SELL, SHOW, SHARE OR OFFER?**

**We're looking for local vendors and community service providers for a one-time Community Open Market at Sunshine Community**!

We welcome **artists • crafters • makers • small businesses • service providers • community organizations • resource groups • nonprofits • specialty vendors • entrepreneurs • and more.**
**Only 10 spaces available — first come, first served!**

📅 **Saturday, September 26 | 1–4 PM**
📍 **1321 Ute Avenue, Grand Junction**

Interested? Call **Rene 970-291-7834** or **Chris 970-712-6540**.
